_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

The Corrupted Village#000.src: Speak to Orikal outside the {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Corrupted Village#000.dst: Habla con Orikal a las afueras de {p} en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Corrupted Village#001.src: Go away! I know you're angry but there's nothing to gain her-
The Corrupted Village#001.dst: ¡Largo! Sé que estás furioso, pero aquí no hay nada que gana-
The Corrupted Village#001.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#002.src: Oh, you seem calm. What are you doing here? Bit close to the portal for a soldier isn't it?
The Corrupted Village#002.dst: Ah, pareces tranquilo. ¿Qué haces aquí? Un poco cerca del portal para ser un soldado, ¿no?
The Corrupted Village#002.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#003.src: I see, you were sent to aid the public. Perfect.
The Corrupted Village#003.dst: Ya veo, te han enviado a ayudar a la gente. Perfecto.
The Corrupted Village#003.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#004.src: I am Orikal, I'm trying to stop everyone here from killing each other.
The Corrupted Village#004.dst: Soy Orikal, intento evitar que todos los de aquí se maten entre sí.
The Corrupted Village#004.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#005.src: Do you see all these spikes? I believe they are the thing spreading corruption.
The Corrupted Village#005.dst: ¿Ves todas estas púas? Creo que son ellas las que propagan la Corrupción.
The Corrupted Village#005.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#006.src: Corruption does not affect humans like other beings. It’s much much slower, more like an infection of the mind to us.
The Corrupted Village#006.dst: La Corrupción no afecta a los humanos como al resto. Es mucho más lenta; para nosotros es una infección mental.
The Corrupted Village#006.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#007.src: Could you inspect the peak of the spike in the village for me? It might give me valuable insight. Thanks!
The Corrupted Village#007.dst: ¿Podrías examinar la punta de la púa de la aldea por mí? Quizá me dé alguna pista valiosa. ¡Gracias!
The Corrupted Village#007.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#008.src: Examine the nearby corrupted spike to the northeast at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Corrupted Village#008.dst: Examina la púa corrupta cercana al noreste, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Corrupted Village#009.src: Climb the spike to see if you can find anything useful about it's existance.
The Corrupted Village#009.dst: Sube por la púa a ver si encuentras algo útil sobre su existencia.

The Corrupted Village#010.src: Report back to Orikal about your observations.
The Corrupted Village#010.dst: Informa a Orikal de lo que has observado.

The Corrupted Village#011.src: That was quick... did you find anything?
The Corrupted Village#011.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#012.src: Really, nothing? You didn't even feel anything?
The Corrupted Village#012.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#013.src: How can it be just a spike? It must be spreading corruption somehow.
The Corrupted Village#013.dst: ¿Cómo va a ser solo una púa? De algún modo estará propagando la Corrupción.
The Corrupted Village#013.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#014.src: Then perhaps my second theory was correct. I will have to send you underground.
The Corrupted Village#014.dst: Entonces quizá mi segunda teoría era la correcta. Tendré que enviarte bajo tierra.
The Corrupted Village#014.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#015.src: There are old cave systems around here from the mining days. I sent two men down to excavate the spike, can you go down and help?
The Corrupted Village#015.dst: Por aquí hay cuevas antiguas de la época de las minas. Mandé a dos hombres a excavar la púa, ¿puedes bajar a echar una mano?
The Corrupted Village#015.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#016.src: The entrance is a little to the northeast. In fact, you should have passed it on your way to the spike.
The Corrupted Village#016.dst: La entrada está un poco al noreste. De hecho, debiste pasar por delante camino de la púa.
The Corrupted Village#016.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#017.src: Find the excavators inside the nearby cave to the northeast at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Corrupted Village#017.dst: Encuentra a los excavadores en la cueva cercana al noreste, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Corrupted Village#018.src: Find the excavators inside the cave.
The Corrupted Village#018.dst: Encuentra a los excavadores dentro de la cueva.

The Corrupted Village#019.src: This is insane, why are we here?! We're looking for corruption you know that right?
The Corrupted Village#019.dst: Esto es de locos, ¡¿qué hacemos aquí?! Estamos buscando Corrupción, lo sabes, ¿verdad?
The Corrupted Village#019.speaker: Alfonse

The Corrupted Village#020.src: Calm down. All we have to do is keep digging. Besides, he did say he'd pay us a lot, so stop being mad.
The Corrupted Village#020.dst: Tranquilo. Solo tenemos que seguir cavando. Además, dijo que nos pagaría mucho, así que deja de enfadarte.
The Corrupted Village#020.speaker: Roy

The Corrupted Village#021.src: Forget it, I don't care anymore, just prime the explosive and get clear of the blast!
The Corrupted Village#021.dst: Olvídalo, ya me da igual, ¡tú activa el explosivo y apártate de la explosión!
The Corrupted Village#021.speaker: Alfonse

The Corrupted Village#022.src: Well, that did the trick. Let's take a look.
The Corrupted Village#022.dst: Bueno, eso ha funcionado. Vamos a echar un vistazo.
The Corrupted Village#022.speaker: Roy

The Corrupted Village#024.src: It almost looks like a giant spike... Woah. How deep does this thing go?
The Corrupted Village#024.dst: Parece casi una púa gigante... Vaya. ¿Hasta qué hondura llega esto?
The Corrupted Village#024.speaker: Roy

The Corrupted Village#025.src: Well, you know what? We did our job, so honestly I don't care. Let's get out of he-
The Corrupted Village#025.dst: ¿Sabes qué? Hemos hecho nuestro trabajo, así que sinceramente me da igual. Salgamos de aqu-
The Corrupted Village#025.speaker: Alfonse

The Corrupted Village#026.src: Orikal? We're done! Pay up! I want out. This place is getting to me.
The Corrupted Village#026.dst: ¿Orikal? ¡Hemos terminado! ¡Paga! Quiero largarme. Este sitio me está afectando.
The Corrupted Village#026.speaker: Alfonse

The Corrupted Village#027.src: I came when I heard the explosion. I thought you'd hurt yourselves.
The Corrupted Village#027.dst: Vine al oír la explosión. Pensé que os habíais hecho daño.
The Corrupted Village#027.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#028.src: Well, I'll be darned. The spike goes this far down? And it looks like it goes even deeper than this!
The Corrupted Village#028.dst: Que me aspen. ¿La púa llega tan abajo? ¡Y parece que sigue aún más hondo!
The Corrupted Village#028.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#029.src: Well, I don't know about you, but I say we blow it to shreds! That oughta get rid of this spike!
The Corrupted Village#029.dst: No sé vosotros, pero yo digo que la volemos en pedazos. ¡Eso acabará con esta púa!
The Corrupted Village#029.speaker: Roy

The Corrupted Village#030.src: For once, I agree. I'll do it, you guys just get clear.
The Corrupted Village#030.dst: Por una vez, estoy de acuerdo. Lo haré yo, vosotros apartaos.
The Corrupted Village#030.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#031.src: ...Wow, that did nothing. We're going to need something MUCH more powerful than TNT...
The Corrupted Village#031.dst: ...Vaya, no ha servido de nada. Vamos a necesitar algo MUCHO más potente que la TNT...
The Corrupted Village#031.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#032.src: Oh yeah? And just what would you have in mind?
The Corrupted Village#032.dst: ¿Ah, sí? ¿Y qué tienes en mente exactamente?
The Corrupted Village#032.speaker: Alfonse

The Corrupted Village#033.src: Well, it's sorta complicated. That's why I've decided to give our new friend here the job of acquiring this explosive.
The Corrupted Village#033.dst: Bueno, es algo complicado. Por eso he decidido encargar a nuestro nuevo amigo la tarea de conseguir ese explosivo.
The Corrupted Village#033.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#034.src: Oh yeah, we were so busy with this spike, we forgot to address you! Sorry about that.
The Corrupted Village#034.dst: ¡Ah, sí, con tanta púa se nos olvidó saludarte! Perdona.
The Corrupted Village#034.speaker: Roy

The Corrupted Village#035.src: Well if you don't need us anymore then we'll just be on our way... WITH our money! So hand it over please.
The Corrupted Village#035.dst: Bueno, si ya no nos necesitáis, nos vamos... ¡CON nuestro dinero! Así que suéltalo, por favor.
The Corrupted Village#035.speaker: Alfonse

The Corrupted Village#036.src: Alright, fine. Here's your pay. Thank you for your help.
The Corrupted Village#036.dst: Está bien. Aquí tenéis vuestra paga. Gracias por la ayuda.
The Corrupted Village#036.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#037.src: Gah! That's hardly anything! I'm not even surprised. Let's just go.
The Corrupted Village#037.dst: ¡Agh! ¡Si esto no es nada! Ni me sorprende. Venga, vámonos.
The Corrupted Village#037.speaker: Roy

The Corrupted Village#038.src: Anyway, come meet me back at my tent, friend. We will discuss what to do then.
The Corrupted Village#038.dst: En fin, ven a verme a mi tienda, amigo. Allí decidiremos qué hacer.
The Corrupted Village#038.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#039.src: Exit the cave and speak to Orikal in his tent about his plan for destroying the spike.
The Corrupted Village#039.dst: Sal de la cueva y habla con Orikal en su tienda sobre su plan para destruir la púa.

The Corrupted Village#040.src: Okay. I happen to know a recipe for creating an extremely lethal magical explosive.
The Corrupted Village#040.dst: Bien. Resulta que conozco una receta para crear un explosivo mágico extremadamente letal.
The Corrupted Village#040.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#041.src: There are {~} main ingredients you will need to get me: [Stabilized Corrupted Ore], [Incendiary Fluid], and a [Switch Fuse] to activate it.
The Corrupted Village#041.dst: Hay {~} ingredientes principales que debes traerme: [Stabilized Corrupted Ore], [Incendiary Fluid] y un [Switch Fuse] para activarlo.
The Corrupted Village#041.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#042.src: There used to be a small mining camp a little east of this town. It's abandoned now, but you should still be able to find what you need there.
The Corrupted Village#042.dst: Al este de este pueblo había un pequeño campamento minero. Ahora está abandonado, pero aún deberías encontrar allí lo que necesitas.
The Corrupted Village#042.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#043.src: It's not the big ol' abandoned mines, mind you. It's a smaller camp, in fact you should be able to see it from this village.
The Corrupted Village#043.dst: Ojo, no son las grandes minas abandonadas. Es un campamento más pequeño; de hecho, deberías verlo desde esta aldea.
The Corrupted Village#043.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#044.src: Best of luck! Oh, and also, try not to die please. These ingredients do indeed promote environmental hazards.
The Corrupted Village#044.dst: ¡Mucha suerte! Ah, y por favor, intenta no morir. Estos ingredientes sí que provocan peligros en el entorno.
The Corrupted Village#044.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#045.src: Find [Stabilized Corrupted Ore], [Incendiary Fluid], and [Switch Fuse] for the TNT at the mining camp at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Corrupted Village#045.dst: Encuentra [Stabilized Corrupted Ore], [Incendiary Fluid] y [Switch Fuse] para la TNT en el campamento minero en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Corrupted Village#047.src: You got 'em all! Excellent, this is exactly what we need.
The Corrupted Village#047.dst: ¡Los tienes todos! Excelente, es justo lo que necesitamos.
The Corrupted Village#047.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#048.src: Alright, stand back. I have actually never made this before, so let's hope I don't cause a disaster.
The Corrupted Village#048.dst: Bien, apártate. La verdad es que nunca había hecho esto, así que esperemos que no provoque un desastre.
The Corrupted Village#048.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#049.src: Phew, glad nothing tragic happened there. This should be it, now go take it back down to the spike and destroy it once and for all!
The Corrupted Village#049.dst: Uf, menos mal que no ha pasado nada trágico. Esto debería bastar; ¡ahora bájalo hasta la púa y destrúyela de una vez por todas!
The Corrupted Village#049.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#050.src: Bring the explosive to the spike in the cave and use it to destroy the spike.
The Corrupted Village#050.dst: Lleva el explosivo hasta la púa de la cueva y úsalo para destruirla.

The Corrupted Village#051.src: Report to Orikal about your success.
The Corrupted Village#051.dst: Informa a Orikal de tu éxito.

The Corrupted Village#052.src: Oh, do you feel that? It's like a buzzing in my ears I never knew about has just vanished.
The Corrupted Village#052.dst: Oh, ¿lo notas? Es como si un zumbido en los oídos que nunca supe que tenía acabara de desaparecer.
The Corrupted Village#052.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#053.src: I think that worked you know. It seems the power of the spike comes from the root...
The Corrupted Village#053.dst: Creo que ha funcionado, ¿sabes? Parece que el poder de la púa viene de la raíz...
The Corrupted Village#053.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#054.src: But what is it connected to? That's for another day. The main thing is the village is safe.
The Corrupted Village#054.dst: Pero ¿con qué está conectada? Eso queda para otro día. Lo importante es que la aldea está a salvo.
The Corrupted Village#054.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#055.src: Here, take this for your help. I found this potato in one of the houses around here, and I sure as heck don't want it!
The Corrupted Village#055.dst: Toma, esto por tu ayuda. Encontré esta patata en una de las casas de por aquí, ¡y desde luego yo no la quiero!
The Corrupted Village#055.speaker: Orikal
